LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Description: The Standard Scrapbook: ready-made items, written here as sheet records, that are dragged onto the paper. Owned by Na__LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__.js. IT IS EMPTY IN THIS APP. TrueVision ships two - a mapping data credentials block and a north point, both site plan furniture and both Noble Architecture's own - and neither belongs here. The file, the module and the section are in place so that a house item can be added by writing it below, exactly as TrueVision's are written: a piece under Pieces (vectors and text in paper millimetres from its own top left), and an item under Items__List naming the pieces it is made of. With no items the section stays hidden, and the Scrapbook tab shows the Parametric and Custom libraries alone.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Pieces: A piece is { Piece__Description, Piece__SizeMm : { WidthMm, HeightMm }, Piece__Records : [ { kind : 'shape' | 'annotation', record } ] }. A shape record may carry Scrapbook__Circle : { CentreMm, RadiusMm, Segments } in place of Shape__Points.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Items: An item is { Item__Id, Item__Name, Item__Description, Item__DrawingTypes (optional; this app has only 'architectural'), Item__Pieces : [ { Piece, OffsetMm : [ x, y ] } ] }.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Tokens: Text may hold {Token} names; each is filled from LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Tokens when the item is built.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Tokens.Tokens__Description: Values that item text may quote as {Name}. None are needed while the library is empty.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Pieces.Pieces__Description: The parts items are made of. None yet.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Items.Items__Description: The tiles the Standard Scrapbook section shows, in this order. None yet, so the section is hidden.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Description: The Scrapbook's wording. Title is the right column's tab, which holds every library; StandardTitle is this library's own section on it. ItemTitle is each tile's tooltip, with {name} the item's name.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Hint: Drag an item onto the sheet. Double-click one to place it in the middle of the view.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__ReadOnly: Items can only be placed while sheets are editable.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Failed: The scrapbook could not be read, so it has no items.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__ItemTitle: {name}: drag onto the sheet, or double-click to place it in the middle of the view.
